evidence.observation: A browser view visibly shows a cryptocurrency bot interface with a prominent SNIPE button and transaction-related fields; subtitles state that the bot will do the rest for the user.
A token-related participation page visibly shows a wallet allowance of approximately 0.6 / 2 BNB and a prompt asking how much BNB to spend.

The frame visibly presents an initial balance, an investment of 0.6 BNB, a final balance, and displayed 3.5x, 4x and 5x figures; the displayed balance boxes show BNB 0.79 initially and BNB 2.02 finally.
